questions.question: Which sequence best describes a typical software-development lifecycle?
options: Plan, design, build, test, deploy, maintain
questions.correctAnswer: Plan, design, build, test, deploy, maintain
questions.explanation: A team plans the problem, designs a solution, implements it, tests it, deploys it, and maintains it.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of version control such as Git?
options: To track changes and collaborate safely
questions.correctAnswer: To track changes and collaborate safely
questions.explanation: Git records changes, supports branching, and lets people collaborate without overwriting each other’s work.

questions.question: Which data structure normally follows first-in, first-out order?
questions.explanation: A queue processes the oldest item first, like a line of students.

questions.question: Why are automated tests valuable?
options: They check expected behaviour repeatedly and catch regressions
They remove the need for users
They are only used after deployment
questions.correctAnswer: They check expected behaviour repeatedly and catch regressions
questions.explanation: Tests provide repeatable evidence that features still work after changes.

questions.question: What does an API allow programs to do?
options: Communicate through defined requests and responses
questions.correctAnswer: Communicate through defined requests and responses
questions.explanation: APIs define how software components or services exchange data and perform actions.

questions.question: Which practice most improves code maintainability?
options: Writing small focused functions with clear names and tests
questions.correctAnswer: Writing small focused functions with clear names and tests
questions.explanation: Focused, readable, tested code is easier to understand, change, and debug.
